status: Specified after the independent 4096-trial opening result revealed high full-game variance, before inspecting any primary-experiment equity estimates.
question: Does removing the cutoff, strengthening late checker play, or deepening cube decisions shift the average fixed-pair gap across this preselected 15-position cohort?
method: For each of the 32 seed-block indices, average each paired difference of move gaps equally across the 15 positions. Different positions have disjoint trial seeds. Use the 32 independent aggregate block means with Student-t intervals (31 degrees of freedom). The three cohort effects form a separate Bonferroni simultaneous 95% family. No pooling with the opening confirmation or prior studies.
usage: Secondary cohort diagnostic only. Does not change the primary 45-effect/60-gap families, trial counts, candidates, or predeclared book-promotion criteria. A cohort effect does not establish the effect or preferred move at every position.
